Q-SUN Xe-1, Xe-2 & Xe-3
Product catalog summary
Overview
Q-SUN xenon test chambers are designed to simulate the effects of full-spectrum sunlight, temperature, and moisture on materials, facilitating accelerated durability testing. These chambers are utilized worldwide across various industries to test materials exposed to sunlight, whether directly, through window glass, or under indoor lighting conditions.
Models and Features
There are three main models of Q-SUN xenon test chambers: the tabletop Q-SUN Xe-1, the rotating rack Q-SUN Xe-2, and the large-capacity Q-SUN Xe-3. Each model is equipped to meet industry standards for weathering, lightfastness, and photostability testing. The design emphasizes ease of use, maintenance, and affordability, with modular subsystems for straightforward troubleshooting and replacement.
Key Features
Full Spectrum Xenon Lamps: Provide realistic sunlight simulation, including ultraviolet, visible light, and infrared radiation.
Programmable Water Spray: Simulates moisture attack with a programmable pure water spray for light or dark cycles.
AUTOCAL Calibration: Ensures fast and error-free calibration of the irradiance sensor.
Versatile Specimen Mounting: Accommodates various specimen shapes and sizes.
Relative Humidity Control: Available in Xe-2 and Xe-3 models for testing interior materials.
Precision Temperature Control: Uses black panel sensors to control specimen temperature.
Long-Life Optical Filters: Durable filters that maintain the required spectrum indefinitely.
SOLAR EYE Irradiance Control: Monitors and controls lamp output for precise light exposure.
Environmental Simulation
The chambers simulate environmental conditions such as moisture and temperature. Water spray and relative humidity control mimic outdoor conditions, while temperature is controlled using black panel thermometers.
Operation and Maintenance
Q-SUN chambers are user-friendly, featuring intuitive programming and automated operation. Specimen mounting is flexible, and the chambers can operate continuously without supervision. Calibration and maintenance are straightforward, with sensors requiring periodic calibration to ensure accuracy.
Specifications and Maintenance
The CT202/IBP sensor must match the type used in the Q-SUN tester. The chamber air temperature sensor is inexpensive and requires annual replacement. The CT202 thermometer needs annual recalibration by Q-Lab. The Q-SUN controller includes self-diagnostic error checking, monitoring system status, displaying warnings, maintenance reminders, and performing safety shutdowns as needed. Typical maintenance includes lamps, sensor calibrations, and air filters.
Relative Humidity Control
Available in Xe-2 and Xe-3 models, these control, monitor, and display relative humidity, black panel temperature, and chamber air temperature.
Accessories & Options
The Xe-3 model offers dual spray for applying a second liquid solution. Various specimen holders are available for different specimen types. A ponding kit is available for water immersion tests, and back spray is required for some SAE test methods. A chiller is available for Xe-1 and Xe-3 models to lower temperatures for sensitive materials. The water repurification system conserves and repurifies water, offering cost savings.
Model Comparison
A summary table compares features across Xe-1, Xe-2, and Xe-3 models, including chamber type, specimen capacity, orientation, 3D specimen capability, lamp type, optical filters, irradiance control, temperature control, humidity control, calibration options, and additional features like water repurification, chiller, ponding kit, dual spray, and back spray.
Global Network
Q-Lab has headquarters in Westlake, Ohio, USA, with facilities in England, Germany, and China. They offer laboratory and outdoor exposure testing services and support customers globally through direct sales and distributors in over 60 countries.

Rotating Rack
Q-SUN Xe-2 The Q-SUN Xe-2 xenon tester offers a large-capacity rotating rack. It is often selected to meet some of the few remaining hardware-specific testing standards. It supports 31 specimens of 46 mm x 122 mm (1.8” x 4.8”) each. Its single air-cooled lamp is more economical than water-cooled lamps, highly efficient and very low maintenance. The versatile Q-SUN Xe-2 tester is the simplest, most reliable, and easiest to use rotating rack xenon arc tester available.
